reason: My tap water's fine and I already have a Brita at home, so I'd just fill my regular bottle from that. Close to $68 today plus another $28 every six months is a lot to pay for water I'm already filtering for nearly nothing.
objection: I don't need it. And signing up for a filter subscription just to make the bottle cheaper feels like a trap to keep charging me.
would_change_my_mind: A real sale where the bottle with one filter costs under $25, ships free and doesn't need a subscription.
